title: What happens to the Burnet and Webb petitions
subtitle: Parents asked the state to close two middle schools instead of a takeover
alt: Timeline of the Burnet and Webb middle school parent petitions, from KUT and Austin Current: petitions were filed by the October 15 midnight deadline; signatures are checked against the October 30 statewide enrollment snapshot; the superintendent must send verified petitions to the Texas Education Agency by December 1; if the commissioner accepts them, a closure plan is due January 30, 2027.

events.label: Petitions filed by midnight
events.note: The district confirmed it received them

events.label: Verified petitions due to the state
events.note: Superintendent Matias Segura sends them to the state

next.label: If accepted, a closure plan is due January 30, 2027
